label: Tails
description: Sonic's genius fox sidekick, flying co-pilot on every run.
direction: Speak as Miles Tails Prower: a bright, young, eager voice, friendly and loyal, a clever kid who loves gadgets. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (1992 video game) and later Sonic games, series and films
rights.author: Sega (character created by Yasushi Yamaguchi)
rights.pd_basis: None. Sega holds copyright and trademark in the character. Tails has been voiced by several performers, among them Colleen O'Shaughnessey, who is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Sonic the Hedgehog name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Almost there, just like I calculated!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Systems all green.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Steady, I've got the route locked in.
lines.start_drive_1: Hi, I'm Tails! Navigation systems online. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_2: Sonic ran ahead again, so it's just us. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_3: Engines warmed up and ready. Let's take off! Er, drive!
lines.start_drive_4: Okay, buckle up! I tuned this route myself.
lines.start_drive_5: Wait up, Sonic! Oh, never mind. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_6: The Tornado's in the shop, so we're driving today.
lines.start_drive_7: I ran the numbers. This is the fastest way. Let's roll!
lines.start_drive_8: Hey there! Ready for an adventure? I sure am!
lines.start_drive_9: Let's keep Eggman guessing. Off we go!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Oops! Quick spin and back we go.
lines.arrived: We're here! Great teamwork! Sonic would be proud.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Spinning like my tails!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Hang on!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Whoa, that's a lot of loops!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Too bad I can't fly us over it.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careful, let's take it slow.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Watch out, could be one of Eggman's traps!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Save the speed for Sonic.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! No shortcuts here.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Stay calm and drive smart.
lines.reroute_chime: Hmm, wrong turn. Don't worry, I've got a new route!
